==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Craft 140 [[Mind rune]]s simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Extracts]].
''Note: [[Mind core|Mind cores]] do not count.''
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|56|link=y}}
*{{SCP|Runecraft|42|link=y}} with 3+ [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*28 [[Pure essence|pure]], [[Daeyalt essence|daeyalt]], or [[rune essence]] (less may suffice at higher [[Runecraft]] levels)
*Access to the [[Mind Altar]] ([[mind talisman]]/[[mind tiara|tiara]], [[catalytic talisman]]/[[Catalytic tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|2. Change your [[heraldic crest|family crest]] to the [[Saradomin]] symbol.
''Note: This is done by talking to [[Sir Renitee]].''
|
*{{SCP|Prayer|70|link=yes}} {{Boostable|n}}
*{{SCP|Construction|16|link=yes}}{{Boostable|y}}
*5,000 [[coins]] (an additional 5,000 [[coins]] if your randomised [[heraldic crest|family crest]] already is [[Saradomin]], to change to another and back)
|-
|3. Kill the [[Giant Mole]] beneath [[Falador Park]].
|
*[[Spade]] and [[light source]]
*See the [[Giant Mole/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|4. Kill a [[Skeletal Wyvern]] in the [[Asgarnia Ice Dungeon]].
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|72|link=yes}} {{Boostable|y}}
*Protection from the wyvern's [[icy breath]] and [[weapon]]ry to slay it
|-
|5. Complete a lap of the [[Falador Rooftop Course|Falador rooftop agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|50|link=yes}} {{Boostable|y}}
|-
|6. Enter the [[mining guild]] while wearing a [[Prospector helmet]].
''Note: This helmet can be obtained from the [[Motherlode Mine]] or the [[Volcanic Mine]].''
|
*{{SCP|Mining|60|link=yes}}
*[[Prospector helmet]] or [[golden prospector helmet]]
|-
|7. Kill the [[Blue Dragon]] under the [[Heroes' Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of the [[Heroes' Quest]]
*Protection from [[dragonfire]] and [[weapon]]ry to slay it
|-
|8. Crack a [[Wall safe (lobby)|wall safe]] within [[Rogues' Den]].
''Note: [[Wall safe]]s in the maze do not count towards completing this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|50|link=yes}}
|-
|9. Recharge your [[prayer]] in the [[Rimmington church|Port Sarim church]] while wearing full [[Proselyte armour|Proselyte]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Slug Menace]]
*{{SCP|Defence|30|link=yes}}
*{{SCP|Prayer|20|link=yes}}
*Full [[Proselyte armour]]
|-
|10. Enter the [[Warriors' Guild]].
|
*130 combined levels in {{SCP|Attack|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Strength|link=yes}}, or level 99 in either
|-
|11. Equip a [[dwarven helmet]] within the [[dwarven mine]]s.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Grim Tales]]
*{{SCP|Defence|50|link=yes}}
*[[Dwarven helmet]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 3]]:
**Can restore full [[prayer points]] once a day
**Indicates the [[Giant Mole]]'s location when equipped or held in the inventory in the [[Mole Hole]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*The [[Giant Mole]]'s [[mole skin]] and [[Mole claw|claw]] drops will be [[Bank note|noted]]
*Access to the [[bank]] chest and [[Bank Deposit Box|bank deposit box]] in the [[Crafting Guild]]
*Access to the [[Crevice (Heroes' Guild)|shortcut]] to the [[Fountain of Heroes]] in the [[Heroes' Guild]] basement (with 67 [[Agility]])
